scope: One normal CUDA model-load and three-request HTTP/tool-transport smoke validation. Not autonomous repository repair, a held-out benchmark, or a speedup estimate.

service.visible_devices: one admitted UUID only; private UUID not published
service.api_auth: Ephemeral owner-only key file; no key/header publication

resource_policy.address_space_limit: Not imposed for CUDA virtual-address reservations; sampled physical-resource guards apply

cases.name: plain_completion
cases.prompt: Return exactly READY, with no other text.

cases.name: forced_function_call_arguments
cases.handler: Read only the actual completed build report; return source_files and source_unchanged

limitations: Three external HTTP requests only; model initialization/warmup may perform additional compute.
Function selection and final JSON response are constrained; this does not prove autonomous planning, editing or maintenance repair.
New compiler/backend/GPU/resource profile differs from earlier CPU runs; no isolated performance or cost comparison.
GPU admission is observational on a shared host; own lock does not reserve resources against other users.
Sampled resource guards are not allocator-enforced hard caps; summed RSS double counts shared pages.
Exact source weight revision behind the community quantization remains unknown.
No model request retry, prompt repair or quota reset. Health readiness GET polling is separate from inference requests.
Existing protected repository acceptance and106 core checks unchanged/not executed here.
